title: Adjusted median income for a small business storefront grant

paragraphs: Your family income must qualify as extremely low to moderate income to be eligible for a small business storefront grant.

sections.heading: Follow these steps to understand your eligibility › 1. Count how many people are in your family.
paragraphs: A family is a single person or a group of people who live together, regardless of actual or perceived sexual orientation, gender identity, or marital status.

sections.heading: Follow these steps to understand your eligibility › 3. Find if your income qualifies
paragraphs: Family of 1 must have an income less than $97,600
Family of 2 must have an income less than $111,550
Family of 3 must have an income less than $125,500
Family of 4 must have an income less than $139,400
Family of 5 must have an income less than $150,600
Family of 6 must have an income less than $161,750
Family of 7 must have an income less than $172,900
Family of 8 or more must have an income less than $184,050
If you are eligible, see how to apply for the small business storefront grant.
